create_vision_transformer_predictor: create a VisionTransformerPredictor model with configurable depth, embed_dim, and patch_size for self-supervised video prediction
build_vit_predictor_factory: build a vit_predictor factory function that instantiates VisionTransformerPredictor with default mlp_ratio, qkv_bias, and norm_layer
run_predictor_forward: run the predictor forward pass with context tokens, mask indices for context and target, and modality type
test_hierarchical_layers: test hierarchical layer selection based on model depth for multi-scale feature distillation
review_mask_token_initialization: review mask token parameter initialization with zero or truncated normal initialization and repeat interleave batching
